value.rationale: The original 2024 study relies on numerical bifurcation, Lyapunov and finite-precision sequence tests. Exact periodic skeleton data are a natural complementary dynamical invariant. The theorem determines an unusual singular infinite-versus-finite resonance, a precise integer-gain staircase (2016 face fixed points at a canonical gain, up to 32640 in the reported parameter range), which states are one-sided expanding, and a nonuniform continuous limit for their positions. This is a natural complete classification for the invariant boundary and a mathematically motivated asymptotic; it is neither a generic normalization fact nor a cryptographic-security assertion.
